items.title: NLP Prediction, Vision Modeling & Clustering: AI Across Data Types
items.summary: Machine learning is not limited to numbers in a spreadsheet. Text, images and unlabeled data all carry patterns a model can learn from. Terms covered: - NLP Prediction: making predictions from text rather than generating it. Routing support tickets by urgency, classifying sentiment in financial news, flagging patients at elevated risk from clinical notes. - Vision Modeling: the same principle applied to images and video. Detecting production line defects in milliseconds, identifying anomalies in medical scans, tracking infrastructure change from satellite imagery. - Clustering: finding natural groupings based on similarity with no predefined categories. The model does not classify, it discovers. Text, images and unlabeled data. Three very different inputs, made meaningful through the same underlying capability. — AI Fundamentals Glossary | H2O.ai University Full playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAWKlIKS-66E Free courses and certifications: https://h2o.ai/university #MachineLearning #ComputerVision #Clustering #AIGlossary #H2Oai
items.summary_html:
Machine learning is not limited to numbers in a spreadsheet. Text, images and unlabeled data all carry patterns a model can learn from.

Terms covered:
- NLP Prediction: making predictions from text rather than generating it. Routing support tickets by urgency, classifying sentiment in financial news, flagging patients at elevated risk from clinical notes.
- Vision Modeling: the same principle applied to images and video. Detecting production line defects in milliseconds, identifying anomalies in medical scans, tracking infrastructure change from satellite imagery.
- Clustering: finding natural groupings based on similarity with no predefined categories. The model does not classify, it discovers.

Text, images and unlabeled data. Three very different inputs, made meaningful through the same underlying capability.

items.title: How the Creator of Claude Code Artifacts Works with AI Agents
items.summary: AI agents now write more than anyone can read. Michael Makarov (founder of Spacesheep, ex-Anthropic) and James Briggs show how to understand what Claude Code and other agents build without reading all of it: live pages, visuals and spaces agents and people share. Recorded live at B Work, Bali, with Michael joining from San Francisco. Michael shares what he learned building an app deployment tool inside Anthropic, why HTML is the format models know best, and a live demo of Claude researching a move to Bali. James shows how he hands work to agents and then understands it through a visual, with a search pipeline as the example. items.title: Nvidia Purchase Commitments Reach $390 Billion With $32 Billion In Neocloud Deals #Shorts #FrontPage
items.summary: Nvidia's purchase commitments reached $390 billion, and the interim chief executive described supplier support as a capital priority, including prepayments that help suppliers expand capacity. That puts Nvidia on both sides of the buildout, securing components while supporting some of the companies that buy its systems. It also reported $32 billion in neocloud commitments, agreements with specialized AI cloud providers, and says it is rigorously evaluating future investments, commitments and guarantees. #AIMNetwork #AI #TechNews #Nvidia #Earnings

items.title: India Non Smartphone Electronics Exports Hit $13.79 Billion Up 56.5% #Shorts #FrontPage
items.summary: Government figures put India's non smartphone electronics exports at $13.79 billion, an increase of 56.5%, lifting their share of electronics exports to about 43%. The growth includes circuit boards, networking equipment and memory products. Routing and network transmission equipment exports nearly doubled to $1.45 billion, and mounted printed circuit boards reached $2.1 billion, with Singapore accounting for most of those shipments. #AIMNetwork #AI #TechNews #Electronics #IndiaExports
